name: Frost Barbarian
desc: A rugged barbarian with fur straps, war paint and a horned helm. Made for snowy raids and tundra camps.

name: Elf Archer
desc: A forest elf in leaf-green leather with a quiver strap and hood. For players who live in the treetops.

name: Dwarf Miner
desc: A stout dwarf miner with a beard, iron helm and heavy boots. Born for deepslate and diamonds.

name: Necromancer
desc: A hooded necromancer in bone-white and midnight purple, skull sigil on the chest. Soul sand valley approved.

name: Paladin of Dawn
desc: A shining paladin in white and gold plate with a sun emblem. Smite first, ask questions later.

name: Wild Druid
desc: A druid in bark and moss tones with a flower crown and vine wraps. Speaks fluent oak.

name: Crimson Samurai
desc: A samurai in crimson lamellar armor with a dark kabuto helm. Honor, discipline, and a very sharp katana.

name: Norse Viking
desc: A Norse raider with a braided beard, fur cloak and round-shield colors on the chest. For longboat crews.

name: Mountain Monk
desc: A calm mountain monk in saffron robes with a prayer sash. Punches trees with enlightened fists.

name: Frost Mage
desc: An ice mage in glacier blues with a snowflake sigil and frosted hood. Powder snow optional but encouraged.

name: Cave Miner
desc: A hard-working cave miner with a torch-lit helm and dust-stained overalls. Always digs straight down anyway.

name: Village Blacksmith
desc: A burly blacksmith with a leather apron and sooty gloves. Smithing templates sold separately.

name: River Fisher
desc: A patient fisher in waders and a bucket hat. Has strong opinions about lure enchantments.

name: Village Baker
desc: A cheerful baker dusted with flour, rolling pin at the ready. Bread for the whole village.

name: Librarian
desc: A quiet librarian in tweed with round glasses. Knows every enchantment by heart.

name: Beekeeper
desc: A careful beekeeper in a cream veil suit with honey-gold boots. The bees love them. Mostly.

name: Ocean Sailor
desc: A seasoned sailor in navy stripes with an anchor on the chest. Sunken ships fear them.

name: Village Detective
desc: A sharp-eyed detective in a long coat and flat cap. Solved the case of the missing emeralds.

name: Mail Carrier
desc: A speedy mail carrier with a satchel strap and red cap. Delivers cross-dimension, rain or shine.

name: Master Builder
desc: A master builder with a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Measures twice, places once.

name: Streetwear Kid
desc: Fresh streetwear: oversized hoodie, crisp sneakers and a backwards cap. Spawn-point swagger.

name: Skater
desc: A laid-back skater with a checked shirt, beanie and worn sneakers. Kickflips over fences.

name: Goth
desc: All black everything, silver studs and a streak of violet hair. Listens to discs 11 and 13 on repeat.

name: Cyberpunk
desc: Neon visor, circuit jacket and glow stripes. Hacked the mainframe, then the crafting table.

name: Pastel Dream
desc: Soft pastel hoodie, star pin and comfy joggers. Builds only in cherry groves.

name: Vintage Explorer
desc: Sepia tones, rolled sleeves and a flat cap. Keeps a paper map even with /locate available.

name: Hip-Hop Artist
desc: Track jacket, gold chain and headphones around the neck. Drops bars, then beats.

name: Emo Kid
desc: Side-swept hair, striped sleeves and skinny jeans. Feels the rain of the plains biome deeply.

name: Preppy Student
desc: Crisp collar, knitted vest and loafers. Top of the class in redstone engineering.

name: Rocker
desc: Leather jacket, band tee and studded belt. Plays note-block solos at max volume.

name: Fox Hoodie
desc: A cozy orange fox hoodie with ears, white belly and a fluffy tail-back. Taiga approved.

name: Panda Onesie
desc: A full panda onesie: black ears, white belly, maximum cozy. Jungle pyjama party ready.

name: Cat Hoodie
desc: A grey tabby cat hoodie with ears and whisker stripes. Purrs near fireplaces, hisses at creepers.

name: Frog Onesie
desc: A bright green frog onesie with big eyes on the hood. Swamp jumps not included.

name: Penguin Onesie
desc: A tuxedo-sharp penguin onesie with orange feet. Slide across frozen oceans in style.

name: Bee Hoodie
desc: A fuzzy bee hoodie with stripes, wings on the back and little antennae. Buzz responsibly.

name: Creeper Hoodie
desc: A creeper-green hoodie with the classic face on the chest. Ssssshould not be worn near flint and steel.

name: Wolf Hoodie
desc: A loyal wolf hoodie in taiga grey with a red collar tag. Bones not included.

name: Soccer Striker
desc: Classic striker kit in red and white, number 9 on the chest. Screams GOL at every goal.

name: Basketball Guard
desc: A purple-and-gold jersey with high socks and court shoes. Alley-oops over ravines.

name: Tennis Player
desc: All-whites tennis kit with a sweatband and grass-court shoes. Serves at 200 km/h.

name: Boxer
desc: Ring-ready boxer with gloves up and a champion belt. Float like a phantom, sting like a bee nest.

name: Swimmer
desc: Streamlined swim kit with goggles and cap. Dolphin's Grace not required but appreciated.

name: Cyclist
desc: Aero jersey, race number and padded shorts. Beats any minecart on flat ground.

name: Skier
desc: Insulated ski suit, goggles and a pom beanie. Shreds powder snow without sinking.

name: Marathon Runner
desc: Featherlight singlet, race bib and split shorts. Outruns phantoms at dawn.

name: Goalkeeper
desc: High-vis keeper kit with padded elbows and grippy gloves. Nothing gets past. Nothing.

name: Baseball Slugger
desc: Pinstripe jersey, team cap and high socks. Hits slimeballs out of the stadium.
